tesseract.title: Seeing in Four D
texts: Night 9. A tesseract is a 4D cube: take a cube and drag it along a fourth axis, $(thing)W$(), at right angles to the other three. What you see in the assembler is its 3D shadow, rotating through the W axis - the way a cube's shadow on a wall seems to turn inside out.
Edge colour shows depth in W: $(thing)cyan$() near, $(thing)magenta$() far. Watch an edge shift from one to the other and you are watching it travel through a direction you cannot point to.
Folds matter through a fourth spatial dimension - parts meet in W that could never touch in our three.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 4$() machine.
Too complex for any crafting grid. I built this controller on the $(item)Femtoscale Assembly Line$() - check JEI for the exact parts; I needed every one of them.
